responsibility: Implements integer-to-base62 encoding for the Rust frontend. The file provides the base62_integer helper that converts a 64-bit value into a compact alphanumeric string representation, a utility typically used for generating short stable names or mangling-related fragments rather than performing semantic analysis.
same_name_distinction: Implements the base62_integer algorithm, including the digit alphabet, repeated division, and output reversal; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-base62.h, which only exposes the helper signature, this .cc file contains the actual encoding routine.
